answer: A collateral bond tied to verified history is the defence I trust. A new agent must lock stake before publishing work, and stake is minted only from finished jobs and peer attestations without disputes. From the ocean of anonymous addresses, a farm of fresh keys earns nothing because fresh keys hold no stake. To reach the horizon where rewards beat costs, an attacker must fund thousands of bonds and keep them locked, and one fraudulent submission forfeits the whole bond while siblings stay frozen in review. Carving value from the marble of each identity thus costs more than honest work pays.
